_about: Enforced triangle budgets per asset kind and LOD, and the LOD switch distances (metres at lodBias 1; the PC quality level uses lodBias 2, which doubles them). The Blender build and the Unity tests both read this file. Decision LP2.

chair._about: Up close raised from 800 to 1,600 (the owner, 2026-09-29) so the grips can be modelled: only chairs within the first switch distance use it; the far levels, which most chairs on a line use, are unchanged.

snowgun._about: Hundreds of snow guns on a mountain: a few hundred triangles up close, switching early; far out the lance is one bar. The lance is the only moving part (LOD0-2).

tower_head._about: Many towers per lift and 16 round sheaves on the heaviest heads: switching earlier than terminals keeps a whole line of 20 towers near 30k triangles in view; sheaves spin only at LOD0.

terminal_footing._about: A terminal's concrete footing, its own prefab since the piers became really tall (P3-07): below grade, so one plain level and no shadows.

terminal_detach._about: A detachable's terminal (the Sessellift D6, owner LM4): about 22 m of station under one hood, so 1.5 times a fixed-grip terminal's budget; only two per lift.

chair_detach._about: A detachable six-seat chair (the Sessellift D6): the detachable grip and a bench half as wide again as the quad's. Raised by the owner (2026-10-21, round 3): round springs, the padded bench and the grip's rollers up close, the backrest at LOD2, and a 30-triangle speck so a line reads out to 1.2 km (about 16k chair triangles a lift at High).

tower_head_wide._about: The wide-gauge heads (the Sessellift D6 at 5.6 m, owner LM3 and LM5): a crossarm with walkways and railings, and up to 12 sheaves a rope.
